title: The bid
style: cinematic horror film still, buzzing fluorescent-lit storage unit corridors and a cramped city apartment at night, an eerily detailed handmade dollhouse, dust in the air, sickly green and warm tungsten tones, dramatic moody lighting, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 1. Gina won a storage unit for forty dollars. Nobody else would bid. 🔑

Original fiction. Part 2 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: At a storage auction, the worst sound is silence. It means everyone knows something you don't.
scenes.image: row of rolling metal storage unit doors under buzzing fluorescent lights, a small crowd standing very still

scenes.narration: Gina Ruiz flips abandoned storage units for a living. Furniture, tools, old records. She's good at it. She can smell a bad lot.
scenes.image: woman in her thirties in a work jacket and beanie holding a flashlight, sizing up a storage corridor

scenes.narration: Lot 47 sits at the end of the row, under a flickering light. The auctioneer rolls up the door. Just a tarp over something boxy. Waist high.
scenes.image: open storage unit with a dusty grey tarp draped over a boxy object, a single flickering tube light above

scenes.narration: Opening bid, twenty dollars. Nobody moves. The regulars, the guys who bid on everything, are suddenly staring at their shoes.
scenes.image: group of rough-looking resellers in a storage corridor avoiding eye contact, hands in pockets

scenes.narration: Gina raises her hand. Forty. The auctioneer doesn't even look for another bid. Sold. He looks like a man who just set down something heavy.
scenes.image: tired older auctioneer in a windbreaker exhaling in relief, shoulders dropping, fluorescent light overhead

scenes.narration: He hands her the key and holds on a second too long. Take it home first, he says. It likes to be home.
scenes.image: close-up of an old man's hand pressing a small brass key into a woman's palm, neither letting go
auctioneer's unsmiling lined face in hard fluorescent light, eyes fixed on the covered object

scenes.narration: That night, in her living room, she pulls off the tarp.
scenes.image: woman pulling a dusty tarp off a large object in a cluttered small apartment at night, lamp light

scenes.narration: It's a dollhouse. Handmade. Every brick painted. Every window real glass. And it's her apartment building.
scenes.image: exquisitely detailed handmade dollhouse of an old brick city apartment building on a living room floor

scenes.narration: Third floor. Corner unit. Her window. And inside it, a tiny light is on.
scenes.image: close-up of a miniature apartment window in a dollhouse, a tiny warm lamp glowing inside
